story_text:
## Creators' Reviews
## Featured in
## Meet Fotorgear Campix
## Waist-Level Viewfinder
Flip to open, and look straight down at a 90-degree angle into the top of the camera. Instead of raising the camera to your face, compose your shot from a more relaxed, understated position.
By keeping your camera lower and your presence understated, you can capture the world as it unfolds, without making your subject feel like the center of attention.
A simple shift can change everything. It offers a more discreet way to frame your subject, leaving more room for candid moments and genuine expressions
## Film-Inspired Filters
From nostalgic film tones to distinctive color moods, Campix brings a world of creative possibilities to your photography.
Revisit your photos, explore different filter looks, and discover new ways to express the same moment — without the ongoing cost of buying film or paying for lab development.
Fine-tune its settings to suit your taste, adjust the look to match the lighting and mood, and find the balance that feels right to you.
## Interchangeable Lenses
Most digital cameras lock you into a fixed lens and a single range of focal lengths. Campix breaks free from that limitation with Fotorgear's proprietary T-lens mount, giving you the freedom to switch between compatible lenses and explore different focal lengths, perspectives, and creative possibilities.
Switch between 8mm fisheye, 16mm wide-angle, 60mm portrait, 75mm macro, and 1.55× anamorphic optics for genuinely different perspectives.
If you already own the Fotorgear lens listed above, yes, they are fully compatible with Campix!
## Retro Design
Inspired by the timeless design of classic waist-level film cameras, Campix brings a beloved way of shooting from the 1950s into the digital age.
Make your Campix your own. Customize all 6 filter slots with your favorite recipes, ready to match the mood of the story you want to tell. One simple turn, and your next story has its own signature look.
## RAW & JPG
Campix supports both RAW and JPG, giving you the best of both worlds. Choose JPG for ready-to-share photos, or RAW for greater flexibility in post-processing.
From everyday snapshots to low-light scenes, Campix captures crisp details and rich visual depth in both RAW and JPG. Whichever format you choose, your photos retain high quality and high resolution.
RAW files give you more room to refine your images after the shot. Apply the filter to RAW, then you can adjust exposure, fine-tune highlights and shadows, and bring out details that might otherwise go unnoticed.
You can even explore different filter looks from the same RAW file, giving a single moment more than one creative possibility.
We've received lots of questions and concerns about Campix's image quality. So we’re making original RAW files available for you to check out on your own. We opened up our self-developed RAW Manager app to everyone!
You can now download it to your computer, import RAW files captured with Campix, and explore the actual image quality, try out different filters, and experience all the features we’ve developed so far.
Have any thoughts or suggestions? Drop us a comment! We’re more than happy to hear your feedback!
## Digital Convenience
With TTL Xenon Flash metering, Campix measures light through the lens to help you make more informed flash exposure decisions.
Move your photos with ease. Connect via Wi-Fi for wireless transfers, or use USB-C when you prefer a wired connection. Your photos, ready to go wherever your next step takes you.
## Campix APP
Campix is made for the immersive joy of shooting. When you're ready to make it more personal, the Campix App opens up new creative possibilities.
It also gives you lifetime access to all app features, with more exciting features to come. Everything is yours to enjoy, for life. Now available for both Android and iOS.
Import your own LUTs, customize filter parameters, and fine-tune your favorite looks to match your personal style.
With an open, customizable filter system, your library can keep growing as your vision evolves.
Step into the darkroom and blend two images into one. Layer different scenes, experiment with unexpected combinations, and create images that go beyond a single moment.
Choose from different shutter sounds to personalize the shooting experience, adding another small but satisfying touch to every shot.
For creators who want to go further, Campix opens up even more possibilities with its desktop app.
Import your RAW files and take full creative control over how you refine, edit, and present your images.
From everyday snapshots to carefully crafted edits, Campix gives you the freedom to create your way — whether you keep it simple or take every detail further.

Please note that the price listed is in HKD, which will be the payment currency at Kickstarter checkout. 
Please rest assured that Kickstarter will automatically convert the amount and charge you in your local currency (such as USD, EUR, or GBP). The final payment amount will be converted according to the real-time exchange rate of the payment card.

faq.q: What kind of camera is Campix?
faq.a: Campix is a standalone digital camera built around waist-level composition and a film-inspired shooting ritual. It combines digital convenience with tactile details such as the physical film-advance dial and 36-shot roll workflow—no film is required.

faq.q: Can I change the look of my photos after shooting?
faq.a: Yes. After developing a roll, you can redevelop it with different film recipes as many times as you like. You can then download only the individual images you want instead of saving the entire roll again.
Yes. Campix includes a GN7 xenon flash with TTL support. It produces a crisp burst of light and automatically adjusts flash output to help balance the scene.
Yes. Campix supports JPEG and RAW files with DNG export, giving you more flexibility when editing.

faq.q: What other lenses can I use?
faq.a:
Selected FotorGear lenses will be offered as Kickstarter add-ons:
- 8mm
- 16mm
- 60mm
- 75mm macro
- 1.55× anamorphic
These lenses extend Campix from ultra-wide and creative perspectives to portraits, close-ups and cinematic compositions.

faq.q: Can I attach lenses from other brands?
faq.a: Campix uses FotorGear’s T-mount interface and currently supports selected FotorGear lenses only. Third-party lens compatibility is not available at this stage.

faq.q: Does Campix require a phone to take pictures?
faq.a: No. Campix works independently as a digital camera. A phone is only needed when you want to use the connected developing experience.

faq.q: Is the Campix App free to use?
faq.a: Yes. The Campix App is completely free for life, with no subscription fees. You can use it to connect your camera, digitally develop your rolls, apply film recipes, and select and export your favorite photos.

faq.q: When do I provide my shipping address and pay the shipping fee?
faq.a: After the campaign ends, we’ll send backers a survey to confirm their shipping address, reward selection, and any add-ons. Applicable shipping fees will also be collected at that stage.
After selecting your rewards, you can choose your desired add-ons and quantities on the next checkout page.

faq.q: How can I change my pledge amount or reward selection?
faq.a:
Backers can adjust pledge amounts or switch to a different reward tier by visiting the project page. Additionally, you'll have the option to add any add-on rewards or give a little extra with bonus support. 
For more information, please check out: https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005126814-How-can-I-change-my-pledge-amount-or-reward-selection-

faq.q: What devices and operating systems does the app support?
faq.a:
The app supports:
Mobile: Android and iOS
Desktop: macOS and Windows
